$comment: Report of a gauntlet pre-check card (core.md, section 3) for `qwen -p ... --json-schema @gauntlet/adapters/qwen/report.schema.json`. The schema fixes the form: no claim without evidence, a 'not checked' list that must be present, a commit. Whether the evidence is true is the coordinator's acceptance (core.md, section 2).

commit.description: The commit the card was checked on (git rev-parse HEAD).

summary.description: Итог: one or two lines answering the card's question.

items.description: Every checklist item of the card with what was done for it.

checked.description: Проверено: every claim with its evidence.

evidence.description: command -> output | path:line: quote | URL and version: quote

not_checked.description: Не проверено: may be empty only when the checklist is fully covered.
